answers.description: Segment-level quality scoring (ESA-style 0-100 score) combining two LLM judges: Gemini 3.5 Flash (closed-weight) and Gemma 12B (open-weight, locally served via vLLM), both prompted with the same reference-free error-span prompt (Wmt26SpanTaskV2Directive) and their derived scores combined via a scalar RRWA-weighted mean using a metric-specific (T2 Pearson) static reliability prior per judge.
answers.name: PhraseT2-01
